characters.name: Riya
characters.description: Younger sister of Arun. Stayed in the village.

characters.name: Arun
characters.description: Elder brother. Left for the city 5 years ago after a family quarrel and has not called since.

characters.name: Bhola
characters.description: Village headman. Respected, a bit stern.

characters.name: Mr. Dass
characters.description: Arun's boss in the city. Only heard on the phone.

scenes.summary: Arun arrives unannounced after 5 years. Riya is cold and hurt; they are still estranged.
Kabir teases Arun. The headman walks up.
Arun's boss calls. Work talk with English words.
After Arun apologised, the family has reconciled. The headman is a dinner guest.

lines.speaker: Riya
lines.text: You came back, elder brother?
lines.notes: Cold, hurt tone. Siblings still estranged.

lines.speaker: Arun
lines.text: Yes. I came back.

lines.speaker: Riya
lines.text: Five years, and not one phone call.

lines.speaker: Arun
lines.text: I am sorry.

lines.speaker: Ama
lines.text: Riya, who is at the door?

lines.speaker: Ama
lines.text: My son... you came back.

lines.speaker: Arun
lines.text: Mother, forgive me.

lines.speaker: Ama
lines.text: Eat first. We will talk tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Kabir
lines.text: Hey, friend! The city boy has come back!

lines.speaker: Arun
lines.text: Kabir! You haven't changed at all.

lines.speaker: Kabir
lines.text: I changed. Now I eat twice as much, ask my mother!

lines.speaker: Kabir
lines.text: Welcome, friend! Come, sit with us.
lines.notes: The headman has just walked up. Kabir is grinning. The headman's reaction is not shown.

lines.speaker: Bhola
lines.text: Arun, will you go back to the city?

lines.speaker: Arun
lines.text: I do not know, headman.

lines.speaker: Mr. Dass
lines.text: Arun, the meeting is tomorrow at ten.

lines.speaker: Arun
lines.text: Sir, I will come to the office tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Mr. Dass
lines.text: Don't be late.

lines.speaker: Arun
lines.text: Yes, sir. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Riya
lines.text: Will you leave tomorrow, elder brother?

lines.speaker: Arun
lines.text: No. I will not leave.

lines.speaker: Arun
lines.text: Mother, your food is very good.

lines.speaker: Ama
lines.text: Headman, are you eating?

lines.speaker: Bhola
lines.text: Yes. Arun, your mother waited for five years.

lines.speaker: Kabir
lines.text: And I waited for dessert!

lines.speaker: Riya
lines.text: Welcome home, elder brother.
